ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity (dark) to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the lateral extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous low-intensity (black) mass with high-intensity (white) mottling and focal spots distributed along the lateral outer tips and trailing margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys varying 5-20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges, transitioning from the median notch to the sharp, upward-turned outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scarring) localized on the lower left lobe and along the outer right margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe, extending diagonally across the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe ventral surface; irregular jagged serrations across the trailing edge suggesting mechanical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced hooked protrusion on the distal end of the right fluke lobe.
